svg.aria-label: A server under rising load, cut open: 48 worker threads fill up while only 10 database connections do the work, throughput stops at 400 requests a second, latency goes vertical past the knee, and the server begins shedding
svg.title: A Server Under Load
svg.text: 48 WORKER THREADS · 10 DATABASE CONNECTIONS · WATCH WHICH ONE RUNS OUT FIRST
ONE THREAD PER REQUEST, HELD UNTIL IT IS DONE
CONNECTION POOL · 10 SLOTS · 25 ms A QUERY
10 CONNECTIONS / 25 ms = 400 REQUESTS A SECOND, AND NO AMOUNT OF LOAD MAKES IT 401
ADDING THREADS HERE MAKES IT WORSE · IT ACCEPTS MORE WORK TO WAIT, NOT MORE WORK TO DO
